name: Gobou
source:
A subordinate under Intermedius troops, who is ranked Number Five. In his troops, the members are arranged in a hierarchy to indicate their power status.
Gobou is substantially Chouku's right-hand man in management. Rather than his combat skills, he is well respected thanks to his down-to-earth personality and versatility at work.
He wears a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasa_(hat)]fukaamigasa[/url], but the reason is unknown. Some people say it is related to the User's ability, but the details of his ability are also relatively unknown.
